title: Feature switches
description: Every user-facing feature switch, defined once for every app. A level turns on every feature whose level is at or below it. Content that needs a feature names it with "requires": "<feature id>", so menus can filter themselves. A new feature starts off by default (level more or everything) unless the user decides otherwise, and apps list features newest first in Customize, by "added".

levels.description: The Settings levels, from least to most.

defaultLevel.description: The id of the level a new user starts at.

features.description: One entry per switch, sorted by id.

level.description: The lowest level that turns this feature on.

featured.description: Language ids suggested on the first-run welcome card, in display order. Apps leave off any id that isn't a shipped language.

text.description: User-facing strings shared by every app's menu and Settings.
